crossRefs.note: Because of all my adversaries I have become utterly contemptible to my neighbors, a horror to my acquaintances. Those…
because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked. For they bring suffering on me. In anger…
For the zeal of your house consumes me. The reproaches of those who reproach you have fallen on me.
When I wept and I fasted, that was to my reproach.
Reproach has broken my heart, and I am full of heaviness. I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; for…
With which your enemies have mocked, Yahweh, with which they have mocked the footsteps of your anointed one.
For even Christ didn’t please himself. But, as it is written, “The reproaches of those who reproached you fell on me.”
Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?
But they were filled with rage, and talked with one another about what they might do to Jesus.
Now when they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed at him with their teeth.
Punishing them often in all the synagogues, I tried to make them blaspheme. Being exceedingly enraged against them, I…
When it was day, some of the Jews banded together, and bound themselves under a curse, saying that they would neither…

translations.web: My enemies reproach me all day. Those who are mad at me use my name as a curse.
translations.bsb: All day long my enemies taunt me; they ridicule me and curse me.
translations.kjv: Mine enemies reproach me all the day; and they that are mad against me are sworn
translations.asv: Mine enemies reproach me all the day; They that are mad against me do curse by me.
